name: rocket_forecast
description: Fly a copy of a rocket to a node and report each leg; the game is not touched. Route: the game's pathfinder, re-planned at every node as the game does; a rocket in transit to another target turns round as Rocket.ChangeTarget does (same first hop kept, else a space hop reverses with progress 1 - progress, and a launch becomes a landing on its pad); a landing rocket cannot be retargeted here. Simulated tick by tick as the game runs it: physics steps at Time.fixedDeltaTime and the 0.5 s game tick every round(0.5/dt) steps (gas mass, landing autopilot, engine draw of 18 x throttle/100 mol per Pumped Gas Engine, tanks mixing with the pipe by volume, batteries paying every device's watts per tick); launch with gravity and the game's abort (net acceleration below zero turns the rocket round to land on its pad, forecast too); space hops (progress grows by thrust/mass x dt / distance); re-entry (the confidence check once at the start, 0 aborts back to orbit; then velocity -distance at the profile's altitude); the landing autopilot's rules (Normal, Alternate, Alternate2, FinalApproach); touchdown (soft under 2 m/s at 0.1 m; else a crash landing: under 4 m/s harmless, 4 to 25 m/s engine damage, faster explodes). Thrust per mole comes from the game's own combustion run on a copy of the fuel, so fuel temperature and mix count; the recorded thrust peak keeps rising as the game's does. Not simulated (named in assumptions): heat the tanks trade with the air (the thrust 100 K colder and warmer is given instead), engines other than the Pumped Gas Engine (refused: engine_not_modelled), the RocketCollisionDetector trigger. Each leg: kind (launch, hop, park, landing), from, to, distance (delta-v), outcome (arrived, parked, stalled, launch_aborted, landing_aborted, landed, hard_landing, crashed, timed_out) and detail, seconds, burn_seconds, delta_v spent, fuel start/used/left mol, first tank kPa at the end, mass start/end, battery start/end J, peak thrust, recorded thrust; a landing adds confidence and band, min required and max expected thrust, start altitude and mass, lowest stop altitude, touchdown speed, seconds, last rule, power_lost, fuel_ran_out. Also, with limits (default true): landing_limits from the rocket as its last landing starts (max landing mass that lands undamaged, max fuel+cargo kg, min and max fuel mol, survivable thrust drop %, the heaviest mass whose confidence stays at or above min_confidence, default 0.25), profiles (the same landing at Low 25 km, Medium 40 km, High 70 km, Max 120 km: outcome, confidence, fuel, time, touchdown, survivable drop) and least_fuel_mol (least starting fuel the whole plan succeeds with). column (column_check, default true): structures or terrain in the column the landing sweeps above the pad, tested as the game's overlap spheres test it. Plus route, uncharted, assumptions, succeeded, verdict. Destination: to, else the rocket's target, else its launch pad (return and land). A stop at a space node: park_s, mine (miners and holds draw power), fill_holds or add_cargo_slots (1 kg each; the cargo itself weighs nothing to the game), park_load_w, then_return (fly back to return_to, default the launch pad). What-ifs: fuel_mol, fuel_temperature_k, fuel_mix (e.g. {"Methane": 0.667, "Oxygen": 0.333}), thrust_scale, throttle, cargo_slots, add_cargo_kg, battery_j or battery_percent, extra_load_w, profile. Combustion (1.9.0+): engines burn at the game's rate (0.96), or at Terraforming Reloaded's (its RocketsBurnCompletely world option: 1.0) when that mod is loaded; {rate, source: game or terraforming_reloaded, note} is reported as combustion. Read only; no gateway.

rocket_id.description: A rocket, its rocket network, or any of its parts. Omit when there is one rocket.

to.description: Destination node: its name, map code (as shown, or its number), reference id, or 'pad'. Default the rocket's target, else its pad.

park_s.description: Seconds spent at the destination (mining, scanning).

mine.description: Miners and cargo holds draw their power while parked. Default false.

fill_holds.description: Every cargo slot is filled by the end of the stop.

add_cargo_slots.description: Cargo slots filled during the stop.

park_load_w.description: Power draw per tick while parked. Default what AutoShutOff leaves on, plus the mining gear with mine.

then_return.description: After the stop, fly back and land. Default false.

return_to.description: The pad to return to. Default the launch pad ('pad').

fuel_mol.description: What-if: total fuel in the engines' lines now.

fuel_mix.description: What-if: mole fractions by gas name (Methane, Oxygen, Hydrazine...), normalised.

thrust_scale.description: What-if: share of the measured thrust the engines give; the recorded peak the landing check uses stays.

throttle.description: What-if: throttle for launch and hops. Default the engines' own.

cargo_slots.description: What-if: filled cargo slots now (1 kg each).

extra_load_w.description: What-if: more power draw per tick all trip.

min_confidence.description: Confidence floor for confident_mass_kg and the verdict. Default 0.25.

limits.description: Landing limits, profiles and least fuel (bisection on the simulator). Default true.

column_check.description: Scan the landing column above the pad. Default true.
